decisions.reason: As the flagship citrus crate, its strategic option value remains high and uncertainty is still unresolved, so it is kept open at low cost.

The foldable container line still holds option value from its multiple models, but with no strong signal after four years, the probability of abandonment rises slightly while keeping it remains cheap.
The stackable crate is a less differentiated option with little evidence of market traction, so its option value has diminished and resources are better redeployed, leading to a drop.
The spill-retention pallet benefits from persistent environmental-compliance demand, keeping its option value alive despite unresolved uncertainty.
The differentiated load-retention pallet retains option value from its unique feature, so it is kept while monitoring for clearer market signals.
